انتقيا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَقَيَا (intaqayā) /in.ta.qa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# اُنْتُقِيَا (untuqiyā) /un.tu.qi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# اِنْتَقِيَا (intaqiyā) /in.ta.qi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
